Change Title: Installment Cycle should show month names
Description: Update the Installment Cycle field to display month names (e.g. January, February, March...) instead of the current format.
Current Behavior: Confirmed live (2026-07-09): the Installment Cycle dropdown currently lists numeric duration options - "1 Month", "2 Months", "3 Months" ... up to "12 Months" - representing how many months apart each installment is due, not a calendar month.
Requested Behavior: Show calendar month names (January-December) in this field.
Clarification Needed: IMPORTANT - flagging for client confirmation before implementation: "Installment Cycle" is currently a duration/frequency value (how many months between installments), used to calculate each installment's due date. Calendar month names (January...December) represent a completely different concept (a specific point in the calendar, not a recurring interval). Please confirm which of these the client actually wants: (a) keep it as a duration field but relabel the options (e.g. "Monthly", "Bi-Monthly", "Quarterly" instead of "1 Month", "2 Months"), or (b) add a genuinely new field, separate from the cycle length, such as a "Start Month" picker. Implementing this literally (replacing 1-12 Months with January-December) would break the existing due-date calculation logic.
